foodsEn: tube rice cake with pork & quail egg
stalls.summaryZh: 近四十年老店，糯米軟Q越嚼越香、調味偏重，網友常建議加辣椒；排骨湯清甜，用餐時段內用外帶都排隊，週二公休。
stalls.summaryEn: A nearly 40-year-old shop: chewy sticky rice that grows more fragrant as you chew, boldly seasoned (add the chili, say regulars), with sweet clear rib soups. Queues at mealtimes; closed Tuesdays.
